scenes.say: Red eye. Should you wait, or worry? Here are three signs that mean you go today.

scenes.en: Tiny blood vessels on the white of the eye swell up.
scenes.ta: கண்ணின் வெள்ளைப் பகுதியில் சிறு ரத்தக் குழாய்கள் விரிகின்றன
scenes.say: The white of your eye has tiny blood vessels. Dust, dryness, allergy or infection make them swell, so the eye looks red.

scenes.en: Mild redness or itch with clear vision often settles in days.
scenes.ta: லேசான சிவப்பு, அரிப்பு: சில நாளில் சரியாகும்
scenes.say: Mild redness with itching or watering, and clear vision, often settles in a few days. A cool, clean cloth on closed eyes can soothe it.

scenes.en: Real eye pain, not just itching
scenes.say: Sign one. Real pain in the eye, not just itching or grittiness.
Sign two. Light sensitivity, when normal light feels painful.

scenes.en: Vision stays blurry even after blinking
scenes.say: Sign three. Blurred vision that doesn't clear when you blink.

scenes.en: Any of these, an injury or a chemical splash: see an eye specialist today.
scenes.ta: இவற்றில் ஏதாவது இருந்தால் இன்றே கண் மருத்துவரிடம்
scenes.say: If you have any of these, or an injury or a chemical splash, see an eye specialist the same day. Meanwhile, wash your hands, and don't rub.

scenes.en: Contact lens wearer? Take lenses out if your eye turns red.
scenes.say: Did you know? If you wear contact lenses and your eye turns red and sore, take the lenses out, and get checked quickly. Book an eye test, and keep your eyes safe.
